cohort: A cohort of 79,437 women with singleton pregnancies conceived via Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART), whose maternal data was collected from the National Vital Statistics System (NVSS) between 2020 and 2021.
finding: Pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) partially mediated the association between pre-pregnancy BMI and adverse neonatal outcomes in women receiving ART, accounting for 21.30% of the effect.
